title: Recursive Discovery & Media Classification
objective: Discover staged files recursively and classify actual media/container type independently of filename extension while preserving unknowns and raw source metadata.

changed_since_previous: ARI-05 reached completed_verified and its authority was retired
ARI-06 became the canonical strict successor
the owner authorized the remaining sealed ARI sequence in strict order

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this Codex execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-05 is completed_verified and its bounded RAR/7z adapter contract remains fail-closed when a runtime adapter is unavailable.
ARI-06 may recursively discover staged files and classify actual media/container type independently of filename extension while preserving unknowns and raw source metadata.
ARI-07 sidecar/manifest parsing and all later ARI implementation remain unauthorized.
Provider credentials, external scraping, tester distribution and release/deployment remain unauthorized.
completion_summary: Implemented bounded platform-neutral recursive discovery over supplied staged nodes and deterministic byte-signature media/container classification. Filename extensions never establish type; unknowns and raw source metadata are preserved. No filesystem scanning, archive extraction, canonical acceptance, rights grant, provider access, sidecar parsing, distribution, or release behavior was added.
next_action: ARI-07 is the strict successor and may be governed-started under the owner-authorized remaining ARI sequence.
